$$\cos \theta = \frac{\mathbf{a} \cdot \mathbf{b}}{\|\mathbf{a}\| \|\mathbf{b}\|}$$
In this problem, $\mathbf{a} = \mathbf{u} + \mathbf{v}$ and $\mathbf{b} = 2\mathbf{u} - \mathbf{v}$.

$$\mathbf{a} \cdot \mathbf{b} = (\mathbf{u} + \mathbf{v}) \cdot (2\mathbf{u} - \mathbf{v}) = 2(\mathbf{u} \cdot \mathbf{u}) - \mathbf{u} \cdot \mathbf{v} + 2(\mathbf{v} \cdot \mathbf{u}) - (\mathbf{v} \cdot \mathbf{v})$$
